references.text: Introduces Balaam son of Beor, who was hired by Balak to curse Israel
Describes Balaam as one who practiced divination
Parallel account that the Israelites killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword along with the kings of Midian
Moses explains that Balaam gave advice that led to Israel's sin at Peor
God's prohibition against divination and sorcery in Israel
Reference to how Balak hired Balaam to curse Israel, but God turned the curse into a blessing
Peter's warning against Balaam's way, who loved the wages of unrighteousness
Jude's warning against those who have rushed headlong into Balaam's error for gain
John's mention of Balaam's teaching, which taught Balak to set a trap for the people of Israel
